name: chai-and-trails-editor
description: The visual post editor: TipTap, bundled into static/js/editor.js for Django to serve.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --metafile=build-meta.json "--banner:js=/*! Chai & Trails post editor. Third-party licences: editor.js.LICENSES.txt */" --outfile=../../static/js/editor.js && node scripts/licenses.js
